items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: by the name of old man Martinez, he took the band over

ctx.x: And they got a, my dad didn't know what he was doing.

He was going to be a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a band. And then they got a, my dad's man, by the name of old man Martinez, he took the band over after he got a, and Gilbert, before he left, he bought a whole lot of orchestration. You know, you want to set up band with that. So they had the same Sonny Henry playing the trombone. And they practiced and practiced and practiced. So they asked me to play one day. I don't…
What's the name, but the name's not again?
